message.content:
在目前（2026‑10‑21）這個時間點，洛杉磯（太平洋夏令時間，UTC−07:00）與柏林（中歐夏令時間，UTC+02:00）相差 **9 小時**。也就是說，當洛杉磯是上午 8 點時，柏林已經是下午 5 點。

> **注意**：兩地的時差會因為夏令時間（DST）的開始或結束而變化。  
> - 美國夏令時間通常於11月第一個星期日結束；  
> - 歐洲夏令時間則於10月底最後一個星期日結束。  

如果你需要查詢其他日期的具體時差，請告訴我該日期，我可以幫你確認。

But likely they want the current difference. As of now (2026-10-21), but we don't know if DST is active. In October, both US and Europe have ended DST? Actually DST ends in US early November; in Europe ends last Sunday of October. So as of Oct 21, 2026, Europe might still be on DST until end of October. Let's check: In 2026, DST in Europe ends last Sunday of October. That would be Oct 31, 2026. So on Oct 21, Berlin is on CEST (UTC+2). Los Angeles is on PDT (UTC-7) until first Sunday of November. So difference is 9 hours. So Berlin is ahead by 9 hours.
